To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.
translations.bsb: Each day there were six Levites on the east, four on the north, four on the south, and two pairs at the storehouse.
translations.kjv: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.
translations.asv: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the store-house two and two.
